summary.headline: Astrological Judgments and Talil
summary.text: Astrological chapter list covering star afflictions, joys, light, powers, lunar influences, signs and fulfilled services, the talil or epikratetor as lord of the horoskopos degree, inquiry intentions, rejoicing houses, aphetic places, high-priest inquiries, ships, and a theme by Eleutherios; cross-references cite the Mediolan codex and Vindobon codex.
